summary: refactor(shared): inject account-customer lookups into StripeHelper
description:
Because:

* FXA-14705 moves the fxa-shared db models, and the fxa-shared dist would
  then query an AccountCustomers class with no Knex bound.

This commit:

* Removes the db models import from the fxa-shared StripeHelper.
* Adds abstract getAccountCustomerByUid and deleteAccountCustomer methods,
  which fetchCustomer calls through this.
* Implements both methods in the auth-server StripeHelper and the
  admin-server StripeService.

Closes FXA-14704
